subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `sessions.activity`/`session.activity`/plugin-hook contract now, or should the public activity API wait for the canonical session-activity design?
rationale: The PR creates new Gateway and plugin SDK surfaces whose semantics overlap open activity, attention-state, stale-run, and child-rollup design work, so code review cannot safely choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Repair And Align Before Merge
options.body: Fix the security/scoping issues, rebase onto current main, and align or defer public API pieces according to maintainer-approved activity semantics.

options.title: Approve The New Contract
options.body: Maintainers can deliberately accept the new RPC, event, and hooks after the blocking payload and scoping defects are fixed.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Design
options.body: Pause or close this branch until the broader session-activity issue settles the API shape and remaining semantics.

recommendation.title: Repair And Align Before Merge
recommendation.body: Fix the security/scoping issues, rebase onto current main, and align or defer public API pieces according to maintainer-approved activity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work touches the Gateway, UI session-scoping, and plugin surfaces this contract would extend.
